blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: How much of an image does a detector need to see? Small RGB regions can retain useful evidence of image synthesis even when they reveal little of the full scene. Motivated by single-patch detection, we study patch-wise supervision: a shared backbone classifies explicit crops, each crop receives its own loss, and patch probabilities are averaged only at inference. The procedure requires neither handcrafted residual filtering nor a learned image-level fusion module. Experiments span single-patch selection, multiple generator collections, and four CNN and Transformer backbones. On GenImage, the reported means are higher for the patch-wise variants than for their whole-image counterparts across all four backbones. Comparisons of supervision granularity, source resolution, crop size, and inference coverage further characterize the approach, while post-processing tests and difficult-image evaluation reveal its limitations. Some checkpoints were selected using target evaluation data, limiting conclusions about unbiased cross-generator generalization. Overall, the study identifies explicit local input and patch-level supervision as a simple, useful combination for investigating generalizable AI-generated image detection.
blocks.zh: 一个探测器需要看到多少图像? 小型RGB区域可以保留图像合成的有用证据,即使它们很少揭示出完整的场景. 以一分点检测为动机,我们研究了补丁式监督:共享骨干对显性作物进行分类,每个作物得到自己的损失,补丁概率只在推论时平均. 该程序既不要求手工的残余过滤,也不要求学习到的图像级聚变模块. 实验跨越了单板选择,多台发电机集,以及4个CNN和变形金刚骨干. 在GenImage上,所报告的补丁变体的手段高于所有四个主干部分的全相像。 监督颗粒性、源分辨度、作物规模和推论覆盖面的比较进一步说明了这种方法的特点,而加工后测试和困难图像评价则揭示了其局限性。 一些检查站是利用目标评价数据选择的,限制了对无偏见的交叉生成者普遍化的结论。 总体而言,该研究将明确的局部输入和补丁级监督确定为调查通用AI生成的图像检测的简单而有用的组合.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A visually convincing image need not be locally indistinguishable from a photograph. Image synthesis can reproduce recognizable objects and coherent scenes while leaving differences in texture, reconstruction statistics, or relationships between neighboring pixels. For AI-generated image detection, this raises a practical question: how much of an image should a detector see at once? A whole-image classifier is a natural default, but its input combines local appearance with object identity and scene composition. Resizing that input may also alter the fine-scale evidence that detection relies on.
blocks.zh: 视觉上令人信服的图像不一定与照片无法区分。 图像合成可以复制可识别对象和连贯的场景,同时在纹理,重建统计或相邻像素之间的关系方面留下了差异. 对于AI生成的图像探测,这提出了一个实际的问题:一个探测器一次应该看到多少图像? 全相分类器是一种自然的默认,但其输入结合了局部外观与对象身份和场景构成. 调整输入范围还可能改变检测所依据的细度证据。

blocks.en: We study a deliberately simple alternative: learn from small RGB patches, and combine their predictions only when making the final image-level decision. This choice restricts the spatial context of each prediction without specifying a handcrafted forensic representation. It also changes the unit of supervision. Rather than asking a collection of patches to produce one correct training prediction, we ask each sampled patch to predict its parent image’s label.
blocks.zh: 我们研究一种刻意简单的替代品:从小的RGB补丁中学习,并且只在做出最终的图像级决定时结合他们的预测. 这一选择限制了每个预测的空间上下文,而没有具体说明人工制作的法证表述. 它还改变监督单位。 我们不是要求收集补丁来制作一个正确的训练预测,而是要求每个抽样补丁来预测其母图像的标签。

blocks.en: The study grew out of our earlier EIB-Net [ 17 ] , which selects a low-complexity patch and regularizes its representation with an information bottleneck. A detector based on one selected region raises two further questions. Is useful evidence confined to that selection, or can other regions also be informative? If several regions contain useful but uneven evidence, can a simple multi-patch procedure exploit them without an additional fusion network?
blocks.zh: 这项研究源于我们早期的EIB-Net[17],它选择了低复杂度补丁,并以信息瓶颈来规范其代表. 基于一个选定区域的探测器又提出了两个问题。 有用证据是否仅限于这一选择,或者其他区域是否也可提供信息? 如果几个区域包含有用但不均衡的证据,那么一个简单的多patch程序能否在没有附加聚变网络的情况下利用它们?

blocks.en: Our single-patch experiments motivate this extension. In a facial-image setting, randomly selected patches perform similarly to minimum-complexity patches, while maximum-complexity patches also retain considerable detection ability. This does not mean that all regions are equally useful. Rather, committing to one selection heuristic is not the only way to obtain informative inputs. Multiple crops offer broader spatial coverage; separate patch losses encourage the classifier to use each local observation.
blocks.zh: 我们的单发实验推动了这种扩展。 在面部图像设定中,随机选择的补丁表现与最小复杂补丁相似,而最大复杂补丁也保留了相当的检测能力. 这并不意味着所有区域都同样有用。 相反,致力于一种选择的热情并不是获得信息投入的唯一途径。 多种作物提供更广泛的空间覆盖;单独的补丁损失鼓励分级者使用每次局部观测.

blocks.en: We study patch-wise supervision (PWS): a shared classifier processes explicit RGB crops, each crop receives its own classification loss, and crop probabilities are averaged at inference. There is no learned within-image feature fusion, no requirement for a residual filter, and no need to truncate the backbone. The defining choice is to apply the loss to each patch before any image-level aggregation.
blocks.zh: 我们研究补丁监督(PWS):一个共享分类器处理明显的RGB作物,每个作物得到自己的分类损失,作物概率在推论中平均. 在图像内没有学习到的特性聚变,不需要有剩余滤波器,也不需要截断骨干. 定义选择是在图像级聚合之前将损失应用到每个补丁上.

blocks.en: The experiments examine this recipe across ResNet-18, ResNet-50, Xception, and Swin-T on GenImage and AIGCDetectBenchmark. Supervision and resolution-alignment studies distinguish extracting crops from how those crops are trained. Patch-size and patch-count experiments probe the trade-off between local detail and coverage. Image-processing tests and Chameleon expose important failure modes. We report these existing results with their model-selection limitations, rather than present a newly standardized leaderboard evaluation.
blocks.zh: 这些实验检查了ResNet-18、ResNet-50、Xception和Swin-T关于Genimage和AIGC检测奔驰的这一配方。 监督和分辨率协调研究区分了提取出作物与这些作物的培训方式。 补丁大小和补丁计数实验探索了本地细节与覆盖之间的取舍. 图像处理测试和变色龙暴露出重要的故障模式. 我们报告这些现有成果时有模式选择的局限性,而不是提出新的标准化领导板评价。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • From one region to multiple local decisions. We connect single-patch observations to a multi-patch detector using RGB inputs, a shared full backbone, and inference-time probability averaging. • Supervision as a design choice. We formulate and compare patch-level supervision with an image-level objective applied after pooling, separating this choice from patch extraction. • Evidence across architectures and conditions. We study backbone choice, resolution, crop size, coverage, and post-processing, with detailed results and failure cases that make the scope of the approach visible.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:从一个地区到多个地方决定。 我们利用 RGB 输入器、 共享的完整主干线和推论时间的平均值, 将单相位观测与多相位检测器连接起来。 • 监督作为一种设计选择。 我们制定并比较了补丁级别监督与集合后应用的图像级别目标,将这个选择与补丁提取区分开来. 二. 支助 跨结构和条件的证据。 我们研究骨干选择,解析度,作物规模,覆盖范围,加工后情况,详细发现结果和故障案例,使方法范围明显可见.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: CNN detectors can transfer beyond their training generator under suitable data processing [ 13 ] . Other approaches exploit pretrained representation spaces [ 10 ] , diffusion reconstruction error [ 14 ] , or neighboring-pixel relationships associated with upsampling [ 11 ] . These methods differ in how detection evidence is represented. PWS leaves the representation to a conventional RGB classifier and instead constrains spatial input and supervision.
blocks.zh: CNN探测器可以在合适的数据处理下传输到其训练生成器之外. [13]. 其他方法利用预先训练的表示空间[10],扩散重建出错[14],或相邻相像素关系与取样[11]. 这些方法在检测证据的表示方式上有所不同. PWS将表示留给常规的RGB分级器,而是限制空间输入和监督.

blocks.en: Patch Forensics [ 1 ] restricts CNN receptive fields, applies local classification losses, and averages probabilities at inference. Its experiments include fully generated and manipulated facial images. We impose locality through explicit crops while retaining the backbone’s feature-extraction stages, and examine natural-image generator collections and a windowed Transformer alongside CNNs. This is an implementation and empirical-scope distinction, not a first claim for local supervision.
blocks.zh: 补丁法证 [1] 限制 CNN接受字段,采用局部分级损失,推论时的概率平均值. 它的实验包括被完全生成和被操纵的面部图像. 我们通过明快的收割作物强制各地,同时保留骨干特征采集阶段,并审查自然成像生成器集和一台与有线电视新闻网相通的窗口变形器。 这是执行和经验方面的区别,不是第一次要求地方监督。

blocks.en: PatchCraft [ 18 ] reorganizes texture patches and exploits rich- and poor-texture regions. SSP [ 2 ] selects a low-complexity patch and uses SRM filtering; its ablations also include direct RGB-patch classification without SRM. Thus, explicit cropping and RGB-patch classification have precedents. Panoptic Patch Learning [ 16 ] studies distributed evidence through patch interventions and a contrastive objective. PWS focuses on a minimal alternative: multiple separate RGB classifications, each supervised before within-image aggregation.
blocks.zh: PatchCraft [18] 重组纹理补丁,并开发出富人和穷人的纹理区域. SSP [2] 选择一个低复杂度补丁并使用SRM过滤;其活化还包含没有SRM的直接RGB-patch分类. 因此,明确的作物和RGB-patch分类有先例。 Panoptic Patch Learning [16] 研究通过补丁干预和对比目标传播出证据. PWS专注于一个最小的替代方案:多个单独的RGB分类,每个分类在图像内集合之前都受到监督.

blocks.en: EIB-Net [ 17 ] is our preceding work on entropy-guided single-patch selection with a variational information bottleneck. Here we move from selecting one region toward learning from several regions with the same classifier. The present single-patch settings, previously denoted SPD, are not the complete EIB-Net system; the multi-patch method does not require the bottleneck. We retain their respective results rather than reinterpret cross-paper score differences as a controlled ablation of patch count.
blocks.zh: EIB-Net [17] 是我们之前在有变异信息瓶颈的Entropy-guided single-patch选择方面的工作. 在这里,我们从选择一个区域转向从几个具有相同分类器的区域学习。 目前的单标码设置,之前表示的SPD,并不是完整的EIB-Net系统;多标码方法不需要瓶颈. 我们保留他们各自的结果,而不是重新解释跨纸分数差异,作为控制下补丁计数.

blocks.en: GenImage [ 20 ] and AIGCDetectBenchmark [ 18 ] evaluate detection across generator families. DIFF [ 3 ] and DiffusionForensics [ 14 ] provide supporting facial-image and cross-content experiments. Chameleon [ 15 ] emphasizes a more challenging distribution of high-quality images. Together, these settings reveal both encouraging benchmark behavior and cases where a local-input detector remains unreliable.
blocks.zh: GenImage [20] 和 AIGC Detect Benchmark [18] 评估整个生成家庭的检测. DIFF [3]和"传播法"[14]提供了支持面部图像和交叉内容的实验. Chameleon [15] 强调高质量图像更具有挑战性的分布. 这些设置共同揭示了令人鼓舞的基准行为和局部输入探测器仍然不可靠的情况。

blocks.en: 3 From Single-Patch Evidence to Multiple Observations
blocks.zh: 3 从单一批次证据到多重观察

blocks.en: 3.1 Local input as an inductive bias
blocks.zh: 3.1 当地投入作为一种诱导性偏差

blocks.en: Generation and reconstruction operations can induce structured relationships between nearby output pixels. Figure 2 illustrates this intuition for upsampling-based generation, following neighboring-pixel analysis [ 11 ] . Such relationships motivate examining small regions even when an image is globally plausible. They do not imply a universal signature: photographs also have spatial dependencies, and both classes are affected by camera processing, compression, and resizing.
blocks.zh: 生成与重建操作可以诱发附近输出像素之间的结构化关系. 图2说明了这种直觉,即按照相邻的像素分析[11],进行以抽样为基础的一代。 这种关系促使人们审视小区域,即使全球形象是可信的。 它们并不意味着普遍签名:照片也具有空间依赖性,两个类别都受到相机处理、压缩和再生的影响。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Motivation for examining local pixel relationships. Upsampling can map a low-resolution representation into structured neighborhoods. The illustrated mapping and pixel values are schematic, not measurements establishing a universal artifact or a model of all generators.
blocks.zh: 图2:审查本地像素关系的动机. 上采样可以将低分辨率代表物映射到结构化街区. 所绘制的绘图和像素值是示意图的,而不是建立通用文物或所有发电机模型的测量。

blocks.en: Our working hypothesis is that limiting spatial context can make local evidence easier to use while reducing access to full-image composition. This is an input constraint, not a guarantee of semantic-free features. The gradient co-occurrence analysis in Appendix F offers a complementary view of local image statistics; it is not a component of the detector.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作假设是,限制空间环境可以使当地证据更容易使用,同时减少获得全成像成分的机会. 这是一个输入限制,而不是对无语义特性的保证. 附录F中的梯度并发性分析为局部图像统计提供了补充观点;它不是探测器的组成部分.

blocks.en: 3.2 What the single-patch study tests
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 单行本的测试

blocks.en: The documented single-patch protocol uses a 256 × 256 256\times 256 image canvas and a 4 × 4 4\times 4 grid of 64 × 64 64\times 64 candidates (Appendix A ). Exactly one is selected per image instance for training and prediction. We compare minimum-, middle-, and maximum-complexity selection with random selection. The complexity score aggregates directional filter responses, as in EIB-Net’s selection procedure [ 17 ] ; the classifier receives the RGB patch, not those responses.

blocks.zh: 图3:用最小复杂度选择来说明的单幅研究。 我们还测试中间、最大和随机选择。 最初的标签"Image Entropy"表示一个基于滤波器的复杂度分数,而不是香农 en. 每个实例使用一个RGB作物而不聚合.

blocks.en: Section 5.3 shows that useful evidence is not confined to the minimum-complexity region. Random selection is competitive in the full-data study, while maximum-complexity selection is less accurate but still informative. This supports broadening spatial observations rather than assuming equal informativeness of all patches.
blocks.zh: 第5.3节表明,有用的证据并不局限于最复杂区域。 随机选择在全数据研究中是竞争性的,而最大复杂度选择则不太准确,但仍然信息化. 这有助于扩大空间观测,而不是假设所有补丁具有同等的信息性。

blocks.en: 3.3 Why multiple patches and separate losses?
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 为什么有多个补丁和单独的损失?

blocks.en: A single selected region can be ambiguous or weakly informative even when other regions are useful. Multiple crops reduce dependence on one choice. Coverage and supervision, however, are distinct: a multi-patch model can be trained to classify a pooled image representation or its constituent crops. We investigate the latter so that the objective explicitly evaluates every local prediction. Local decisions become the training units, while the image remains the evaluation unit.
blocks.zh: 即使其他区域有用,一个选定的区域也可能含糊不清或信息不足。 多种作物减少了对一种选择的依赖。 然而,覆盖面和监督是不同的:可培训一个多分幅模型,对集合图像代表或其组成作物进行分类。 我们调查后一种情况,以便目标明确评价每个地方的预测。 地方决定成为培训单位,而形象仍然是评价单位。

blocks.zh: 4 补丁监督

blocks.en: Explicit cropping constrains the input’s visual field without truncating the feature extractor. We evaluate ResNet-18/50 [ 6 ] , Xception [ 4 ] , and Swin-T [ 9 ] . Each backbone still requires a valid input-size configuration, explicitly set in the available Swin wrapper. The method is simple to implement, but its cost depends on input size and patch count. blocks.zh: 明确裁剪会限制输入的视觉场而不会截断特性提取器. 我们评价ResNet-18/50[6]、Xception[4]和Swin-T[9]。 每个主干仍然需要有效的输入大小配置,明确设置在可用的Swin包装中. 该方法执行简单,但其成本取决于输入大小和补丁计数. 多种农作物不会自动快于一整相通,多收的农作物不需要单调提高精度.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: Our experiments address three questions: how much detection evidence survives in a single local crop; whether patch-wise learning transfers across generators and backbone architectures; and how supervision, spatial resolution, and inference coverage affect the result. We also examine image processing and difficult evaluation images to identify the approach’s limitations.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验涉及三个问题:在单一的局部作物中存活的探测证据有多少;在发电机和主干结构之间是否进行补丁学习转移;以及监督、空间分辨率和推论覆盖面如何影响结果。 我们还审查图像处理和难以评价的图像,以确定方法的局限性。

blocks.en: 5.1 Evaluation settings
blocks.zh: 5.1 评价设置

blocks.en: The principal multi-patch experiments use GenImage [ 20 ] and AIGCDetectBenchmark [ 18 ] , abbreviated AIGCD. For GenImage, the training generator is SD v1.4 and evaluation covers eight generator subsets, including the training generator and BigGAN. For AIGCD, our models are trained on ProGAN and evaluated on the sixteen subsets listed in Appendix B . These benchmark means include the source generator; they are not exclusively unseen-generator averages. The two collections provide complementary diffusion-source and GAN-source settings. Single-patch studies use the DIFF facial-image setting [ 3 ] and a separate LSUN-to-ImageNet transfer setting from DiffusionForensics [ 14 ] . Chameleon [ 15 ] tests performance on a more challenging collection of real and generated images.
blocks.zh: 主要多平面实验使用GenImage [20]和AIGC Detect Benchmark [18],缩写为AIGCD. 对于GenImage,训练发电机为SD v1.4,评价涵盖8个发电机子集,包括训练发电机和BigGAN. 就AIGCD而言,我们的模型接受了关于ProGAN的培训,并对附录B所列的16个子集进行了评估。 这些基准手段包括源生成器;它们并非完全是无形生成器平均值。 这两个集提供了互补的传播源和GAN源设置. 单平面图研究使用DIFF面相图设定 [3] 从 DifusionForensics 单独使用 LSUN-to-ImageNet 传输设置 [14]. 变色龙 [15]测试性能 更具有挑战性 收集真实和生成的图像。

blocks.en: We use ResNet-18, ResNet-50 [ 6 ] , Xception [ 4 ] , and Swin-T [ 9 ] to examine the same learning recipe with convolutional and Transformer backbones. Unless stated otherwise, the multi-patch setting uses 64 × 64 64\times 64 crops and up to 64 inference patches. Accuracy is computed from the mean patch probability with threshold 0.5; average precision (AP) measures image-level ranking. Reported benchmark means average generator subsets rather than random seeds. For Chameleon, we show both class accuracies and balanced accuracy to expose class-dependent errors.
blocks.zh: 我们用ResNet-18,ResNet-50 [6],Xception [4],和Swin-T [9] 来用革命和变形器骨干来审查同样的学习秘方. 除非另有说明,多幅布置使用64×64 64\times 64作物和最多64个推论补丁. 精确度从0.5阈值的平均补丁概率来计算;平均精确度(AP)衡量图像级别排名. 被报告的基准是指平均生成子集而不是随机种子. 对于Chameleon来说,我们既显示类敏捷度,又显示平衡的准确度来揭露依赖类的错误.

blocks.en: The earlier manuscript describes native-resolution cropping for the default multi-patch setting, followed by backbone-specific transforms, and a separate resolution-aligned control. The retained source instead applies a 299 × 299 299\times 299 source resize annotated as an ablation, then passes normalized 64 × 64 64\times 64 patches directly to the feature extractors. Neither this snapshot nor the public implementation certifies the complete preprocessing history of every reported run. We distinguish source resizing from post-crop resizing and retain the historical settings separately; Appendix A.2 gives the version details.
blocks.zh: 更早的手稿描述为默认多patch设置的本土解析收割,再由主干切变接而来,另作解析相通的控制. 所保留源反而应用了299×299 299\times 299 s source 重新将注解为ablook,再将64×64\times 64 补丁正常地直接通过特性提取器. 无论是这一简况还是公共执行,都无法证明每一次报告运行的全部预处理历史。 我们区分出源重回大小与后作物重回大小,并分别保留历史设置;附录A.2给出了版本细节.

blocks.en: This paper reports the existing experiments without new training. External-method scores are retained from the original comparison tables, with attribution, rather than presented as newly rerun baselines. Historical checkpoint and run selection was not uniform: validation-based selection was used where available, but some results were chosen using target evaluation performance. In particular, the ResNet-50 GenImage result of 95.40 follows a scan maximizing the eight-subset evaluation average; the SD v1.4-trained Xception Chameleon result of 71.29 is the best checkpoint in a Chameleon evaluation scan. Other rows’ complete selection histories have not been recovered. Because selection histories are not consistently matched or fully recovered, the reported patch-versus-whole-image differences do not establish the direction or magnitude of gains under a common evaluation protocol. Superscript T marks documented target-selected results; unmarked results from our experiments have incompletely recovered selection histories, rather than verified source-only selection. External-method rows retain their original attribution. Target-based selection can make reported scores optimistic even without using those images for gradient updates. We retain the comparisons to show the observed behavior, but do not interpret their differences as an unbiased state-of-the-art ranking or as statistically established effect sizes. Known numerical inconsistencies are identified locally and in Appendix A.5 .
blocks.zh: 本文报告的是未经新培训的现有实验。 外部方法的分数保留在原比较表中,带有归属,而不是作为新重播的基线. 历史检查点和运行选择并不统一:在有验证选择的地方使用验证选择,但有些结果使用目标评价性能选择. 特别是,95.40的ResNet-50GenImage结果遵循了8个子集评价平均值最大化的扫描结果;71.29的SD v1.4训练Xception Chameleon结果是Chameleon评价扫描中最好的检查点. 其他行的完整选取历史还没有找到。 由于选择历史并非一致匹配或完全恢复,所报告的补丁与全成像差异无法确定共同评价协议下的收益方向或规模。 上标 T标记所记录的目标选择结果;我们实验的无标记结果没有完全恢复选择历史,而不是经过核实的纯源选择。 外出方法行保留原有归属. 基于目标的选择即使不使用这些图像进行梯度更新,也能使报告得分乐观。 我们保留比较,以显示所观察到的行为,但不将其差异解释为无偏见的最新排名或统计上确定的效应大小. 已知的数字不一致之处在当地和附录A.5中予以识别。

blocks.en: For the same Xception run, a separate evaluation of its saved best checkpoint reports 68.03 on Chameleon, compared with 71.29 from the Chameleon checkpoint sweep. This 3.26-point difference illustrates sensitivity to checkpoint selection, not an unbiased estimate of test-selection bias (Appendix A.3 ).
blocks.zh: 在同一次Xception跑道上,对其保存的关于变色龙的68.03次最佳检查站报告进行了单独评价,相比之下,变色龙检查站扫荡结果为71.29. 这一3.26分的差异表明对检查站选择的敏感性,而不是对测试选取偏差的无偏见估计(附录A.3)。

Table 1 compares minimum-, middle-, and maximum-complexity selection with random selection. This is a single-patch detection baseline (SPD), not the complete EIB-Net model with its information-bottleneck module.

blocks.en: Random selection reaches 98.78%, close to the whole-image result of 99.01% and slightly above minimum-complexity selection. Even maximum-complexity crops retain substantial detection ability, although their 94.91% accuracy is clearly lower. The result motivates using local RGB content without requiring one privileged texture range. It does not imply that every region is equally informative. In particular, committing to one selected crop can discard useful evidence elsewhere in the image. Multi-patch inference addresses this coverage issue while maintaining patch-level training predictions.
blocks.zh: 随机选择达到98.78%,接近99.01%的全图像结果,略高于最小复杂度选择. 即使是最复杂作物,其检测能力也很大,尽管其94.91%的精度明显较低。 结果激发了使用本地RGB内容而不需要一个特权纹理范围. 这并不意味着每个区域都有同样的信息。 特别是,对一种选定的作物作出承诺可以丢弃图像中其他地方的有用证据。 多标码推论解决了这一覆盖问题,同时保持了补丁级培训预测.

blocks.en: Figure 5 compares the recorded training and validation trajectories for whole-image, single-patch, and multi-patch models. The whole-image run has a larger train–validation gap, while the patch-based runs track validation performance more closely. This observation complements the final scores: local-input learning can change optimization behavior as well as the evaluation result. The curves alone do not identify which visual cues the models use or prove the removal of semantic bias. Further single-patch selection, training-data, and transfer results are retained in Appendix D .

blocks.en: Figure 5: Recorded training and validation accuracy over 200 epochs, shown with the original 10-epoch moving-average visualization. Ori denotes whole-image learning, SPD the single-patch study, and PWS patch-wise supervision. These trajectories illustrate observed training behavior, not a causal test of the learned features.

These comparisons do not establish the direction or magnitude of gains under a common selection protocol (Section 5.1 ). External-method rows provide context, rather than an unbiased method ranking.

blocks.en: Table 3 summarizes the second source setting, with full per-generator accuracy and AP in Appendix B . PWS reaches mean accuracies of 88.41–93.43 across the four backbones. Swin-T and Xception obtain 93.43 and 93.02, respectively, compared with the listed 92.77 for AIDE and 89.31 for PatchCraft. The smaller ResNet models do not exceed all external baselines, which is important when interpreting the recipe as a portable design rather than a universal performance guarantee.
blocks.zh: 表3概括了第二个源的设置,附录B中的每个源的完全准确性和AP. PWS在四个骨干柱上达到88.41-93.43的平均值. Swin-T和Xception分别获得93.43和93.02,而AIDE和PatchCraft分别获得上市的92.77和89.31. 较小的ResNet模型不会超过所有外部基线,这在将食谱解释为可移植设计而不是通用性能保障时很重要.

blocks.en: The detailed results also show a persistent weakness on GauGAN: PWS accuracy ranges from 57.08 for ResNet-18 to 76.80 for Swin-T. At the same time, average AP is appreciably higher than fixed-threshold accuracy; for example, ResNet-50 obtains 95.11 AP versus 89.35 accuracy. Thus, a useful score ranking need not yield a well-calibrated threshold across generators. These observations motivate examining both the local feature representation and how patch scores are calibrated and aggregated.
blocks.zh: 详细结果还显示高干上持续存在弱点:PWS精度从ResNet-18的57.08到Swin-T的76.80. 同时,平均AP明显高于固定门槛的准确性;例如,ResNet-50获得95.11 AP对89.35的准确性. 因此,一个有用的分数排名不需要产生一个经过适当调整的发电机阈值。 这些观察促使人们审查当地的特征表现以及如何校准和汇总补丁分数。

blocks.en: 5.4 What changes when the supervision unit changes?
blocks.zh: 5.4 (中文(简体) ). 监管单位变更时有何变化?

Table 4 shows higher GenImage means for patch-level supervision on all three evaluated backbones: 95.40 versus 72.40 for ResNet-50, 95.21 versus 80.19 for Xception, and 93.58 versus 77.70 for Swin-T.

blocks.en: The distinction is practically consequential: requiring each crop to predict the label discourages a model from satisfying the objective only through a few easy regions. Nevertheless, the numerical comparison does not isolate semantic bias as the causal explanation. The objectives also differ in optimization and example weighting, while shared parameters and batch statistics remain. The supported conclusion is that explicit local input and per-patch loss should be considered together; simply introducing patches does not specify the training problem.
blocks.zh: 这种区别实际上是间接的:要求每个作物都对标签进行预测,使一个模型无法通过几个容易实现的目标。 尽管如此,数字比较并不孤立语义偏差作为因果解释. 目标在优化和实例权重方面也各不相同,而共享的参数和批量统计依然存在. 得到支持的结论是,应一并考虑明确的本地投入和每分寸损失;仅仅引入补丁并不能说明培训问题。

blocks.zh: 5.5 分辨率、补丁大小和推断覆盖范围

blocks.en: A default crop can preserve local information that global resizing removes. The aligned experiment first resizes each image to the whole-image baseline’s canvas, then extracts patches. Table 5 compares this setting with whole-image and default-patch processing.

blocks.en: The reported aligned-PWS means exceed the whole-image means by 10.15 percentage points for ResNet-50 and 6.01 points for Xception; the reported default-PWS means are higher still. These are descriptive differences between historical results. Unresolved preprocessing and selection histories prevent interpreting them as isolated effects of source resolution or supervision granularity.

blocks.en: The 64 × 64 64\times 64 setting has the highest mean in the Xception comparison on both benchmarks (Table 6 ). Smaller crops reduce the available spatial context, while larger crops alter the balance between local detail and broader image structure. The observed optimum is therefore a useful default for these experiments, not a universal property of generated images. Per-generator changes in Appendix C also show why a single mean should not substitute for examining individual distributions.

The reported means are not monotonic as the count increases further. This study concerns inference coverage for a patch-trained classifier, rather than the separate single-patch training experiment in Table 1 .

blocks.en: These results suggest a coverage–cost trade-off rather than a rule that more crops are always better. Selecting fewer informative patches, weighting unreliable predictions, and accounting for overlapping evidence are natural extensions, but are not required by the simple mean-aggregation method evaluated here.

blocks.en: The relative ordering in these recorded results is encouraging, but the clean-to-processed decline exposes an important limitation of local detection. Resizing and compression modify precisely the fine-scale statistics on which a local classifier may depend. This can affect real photographs as well as synthetic images. Robust local evidence should therefore be studied alongside realistic acquisition and post-processing pipelines, rather than equated with invariance to such operations.
blocks.zh: 这些记录结果的相对顺序令人鼓舞,但清洁到加工的下降暴露出当地检测的重要局限性. 调整和压缩精确修改当地分类员可能依赖的精细尺度统计。 这可以影响真实相片以及合成相片. 因此,应当结合现实的购置和加工后管道,研究强有力的当地证据,而不应等同于对此类业务的干扰。

blocks.en: The class breakdown in Table 9 shows differences in reported performance and substantial remaining failure. The listed AIDE models recognize real images well but detect relatively few synthetic examples. PWS has higher reported synthetic-class accuracy in these comparisons, reaching 37.58 with SD v1.4-trained Xception while retaining 96.63 real-class accuracy. However, this still means that most synthetic images are missed at the fixed threshold. Its 71.29 overall accuracy corresponds to only 67.11 balanced accuracy and, as noted in Section 5.1 , uses a target-selected checkpoint. The result describes a target-selected operating point in this difficult setting; it does not establish a gain under an independent selection protocol or reliable open-world detection.
blocks.zh: 表9中的分类细目显示,报告业绩有差异,其余大量故障。 列出的AIDE模型很好地识别出真实的图像,但检测出相对较少的合成实例. PWS在这些比较中报告的合成级精度较高,与SD v1.4训练的Xception达到37.58,同时保留了96.63活性级精度. 然而,这仍然意味着大多数合成图像在固定阈值被忽略. 其71.29总的准确度仅相当于67.11的均衡准确度,如第5.1节所指出,使用目标选定的检查站。 结果描述了在这个困难的设定中一个目标选择的操作点;它没有在独立的选择协议或可靠的开放世界检测下建立收益.

blocks.en: Taken together, the experiments favor treating local RGB classification and its supervision unit as meaningful design choices. They also show why the scope of the conclusion matters: useful local signals need not exist in every crop, transfer uniformly to every generator, survive all processing, or support a single universal decision threshold.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些实验倾向于将当地RGB分类及其监督单位视为有意义的设计选择。 它们也显示了结论的范围为何重要:在每种作物中不需要存在有用的局部信号,统一转移给每个生成器,在所有处理中幸存下来,或者支持单一的普遍决定阈值.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: The study supports treating spatial input and supervision granularity as useful design choices. A standard RGB classifier can learn from small regions; multiple decisions provide broader coverage; and patch-level training performs favorably across the tested backbones in the reported comparisons. This makes a simple alternative to specialized forensic representations worth studying, without assuming every architecture or distribution will benefit.
blocks.zh: 该研究支持将空间输入和监督颗粒性作为有用的设计选择。 一个标准的RGB分类员可以从小区域学习;多种决定提供更广泛的覆盖面;补丁级培训在报告的比较中,在经过测试的骨干中表现优异。 这使得除了值得研究的专门法证陈述之外,一个简单的替代方法,而不假定每个建筑或分布都会受益.

blocks.en: Restricting the visual field reduces access to full-image composition, but crops can still contain semantic cues, compression differences, and other provenance shortcuts. The supervision and resolution experiments help distinguish design choices; they do not uniquely attribute improvements to neighboring-pixel generation patterns. Likewise, gradient co-occurrence describes input statistics, not the network’s learned features. Broader crop coverage, the augmentation effect of training on multiple local views, and inference-time averaging of correlated predictions may also contribute to the reported behavior; the present comparisons do not isolate their contributions from those of spatial context and supervision granularity. Stronger causal claims require controls beyond this study.
blocks.zh: 限制视觉场会减少对全成像成分的获取,但农作物仍然可以包含语义提示,压缩差异等出处快捷键. 监督和解析实验有助于区分设计选择;它们并不将改进与相邻-像素生成模式有独特的属性. 同样,梯度共发描述的是输入统计,而不是网络学到的特征。 作物覆盖面扩大、多种地方观点培训的增强效应以及相关预测的推断-时间平均值也可能助长所报告的行为;目前的比较并不将它们与空间背景和监督颗粒性的贡献分开。 更强烈的因果关系要求需要本研究以外的控制。

blocks.en: Uniform averaging gives clear, ambiguous, and corrupted regions equal weight. Overlap can introduce redundancy. Adaptive selection and confidence-weighted pooling are possible extensions, but their benefit is not established here. Furthermore, inheriting an image label for every crop targets fully synthesized images. Partial edits and mixed real/synthetic compositions require different treatment of local labels and are outside the demonstrated scope.
blocks.zh: 统一平均率使明显、模棱两可和腐败地区同等重要。 重叠可以引入冗余. 适应性选择和信心加权集合是可能的延伸,但其好处在此没有确立. 此外,为每个作物目标继承一个图像标签,充分合成图像。 部分编辑和混合真实/合成成分需要对本地标签进行不同的处理,并不属于所显示的范围.

blocks.en: The selection practices in Section 5.1 limit score interpretation: evaluation-selected results can be optimistic, and cross-method selection budgets are not matched. The comparisons characterize reported behavior rather than establish an unbiased state-of-the-art ranking. The experiments also do not provide systematic multi-seed estimates. Difficult-image failures and processing sensitivity show that high benchmark averages alone do not establish reliability in deployment.
blocks.zh: 第5.1节中的选择做法限制分数解释:评价选定结果可以乐观,跨方法选择预算不相匹配. 比较是所报告行为的特征,而不是确定一个无偏见的最新排名。 这些实验也没有提供系统的多种子估计. 难以实现的图像故障和处理敏感性表明,仅高基准平均数并不能确定部署的可靠性。

blocks.en: A detector score is supporting evidence, not proof of image origin. False positives can cause harmful accusations; high real-image accuracy can also coexist with low synthetic-image recall. The public reference implementation is available at https://github.com/LF-Jade/look-closer . It covers multi-patch PWS sampling, patch-level training, and image-level evaluation, with configuration and historical-version limitations documented in the repository. The historical single-patch selection implementation is not included, and no detector checkpoints trained for this study are provided. The release is not a guarantee that every reported score can be reproduced.
blocks.zh: 探测器分数是支持证据,而不是图像出自证据. 假阳性可引起有害的指责;高实相精度也可与低合成相像回想并存. 公众参考执行情况见https://github.com/LF-Jade/look-closer。 它涵盖多patch PWS采样,补丁级培训和图像级评价,配置和历史版限制在寄存器中被记录. 以往的单行区选择执行不包括在内,也没有为这项研究提供经过培训的探测器检查站。 发行并不能保证每个上报的分数都能被复制.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We studied a simple route from single-patch evidence to multi-patch detection: explicitly crop RGB regions, train a shared classifier with a loss for each patch, and average probabilities at inference. The experiments motivate looking beyond one specially selected region and report higher GenImage means for PWS than for the whole-image baselines across four tested backbones, with selection histories that limit conclusions under a common evaluation protocol. Supervision, resolution, and coverage studies characterize the design space, while processing sensitivity and difficult-image failures define its limits. The work offers a practical recipe and observations for further investigation of local supervision, without requiring a new feature extractor or claiming that local evidence alone solves image authenticity.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了从一分点证据到多分点检测的简单路径:明确收割RGB区域,训练一个共享分类器,每分点损失一个,推论平均概率. 这些实验激励人们超越一个特别选定的区域,并报告PWS的Genimage手段高于四个经测试的主干线的全成像基线,其选择历史限制了共同评价协议下的结论。 监督、分辨率和覆盖面研究是设计空间的特点,而处理敏感性和困难图像故障则界定其限度。 该作品为进一步调查地方监督提供了实用的配方和意见,而不需要新的特征提取器或声称仅由地方证据就能解决图像的真实性.

blocks.en: A.2 Input resolution and historical variants

blocks.en: Two spatial operations must be distinguished: resizing the source image before cropping , and resizing an extracted patch before the backbone . In the saved multi-patch source, a 64 × 64 64\times 64 patch is passed directly to ResNet, Xception, or Swin after normalization. The model wrappers do not silently enlarge it to 224 × 224 224\times 224 or 299 × 299 299\times 299 . In particular, a pretrained model’s identifier is not evidence that its default input transform is applied.
blocks.zh: 必须区分两种空间操作:在裁剪前重新调整源图像的大小;在主干前重新调整提取补丁的大小。 在被保存的多patch源中,一个64×64\times 64补丁直接传递到ResNet,Xception,或Swin在正常化后. 型号包装机没有默默地将其扩展至224×224×224×299×299×299×299等. 特别是,预先训练过的模型的标识符并不是其默认输入转换被应用的证据.

blocks.en: The earlier manuscript describes native-resolution cropping for the default multi-patch setting, followed by the same backbone-specific transforms as the paired whole-image baseline. Its resolution-aligned control instead resizes the source to a fixed 224 × 224 224\times 224 or 299 × 299 299\times 299 canvas before cropping and then enlarges the extracted patches to the backbone input size. The retained sampler unconditionally applies a 299 × 299 299\times 299 resize before cropping, explicitly annotated as an ablation, whereas the retained model path consumes 64 × 64 64\times 64 patches directly. The snapshot therefore documents a resize-before-crop ablation path but does not establish an exact implementation match to either complete manuscript pipeline or identify the transform version used for every historical result. We retain the reported settings as distinct historical comparisons, without treating their differences as isolated effects of resolution. The public implementation defaults to native-resolution cropping with direct- 64 64 input; this is an explicit release configuration, not a claim to have recovered the full historical pipeline.
blocks.zh: 更早的手稿描述了默认多相克设置的本土分辨率裁剪,之后与配对的全相克基线一样的骨干特异变换. 它的分辨率对齐控制反而在裁剪前将源头大小调整为固定的224×224 2.24\times 224或299×299\times 299画布,再将所提取的补丁扩展为主干输入大小. 所保留的采样器无条件在收割前采用299×29929\times 299的重排大小,被明确注解为通缩,而所保留的模型路径直接消耗了64×6464\times 64补丁. 因此,该快照记录了作物种植前的调整尺寸路径,但没有确定与完整的手稿管道或确定每个历史结果所用的变换版本的确切执行匹配。 我们保留所报告的环境作为独特的历史比较,而不把它们的差异视为分辨率的孤立影响。 公开实施默认采用直接-64 64输入的自有分辨率收割方式;这是一种明确的放行配置,而不是声称已收回了全部历史管线.

blocks.en: A.3 Checkpoint counters and selection example
blocks.zh: A.3 检查站柜台和选择实例

blocks.en: When the save interval is positive, the training loop increments a checkpoint counter every specified number of batch steps. A filename such as epoch146.pth need not mean the 146th completed training epoch. For the representative ResNet-50 schedule, 30 epochs with image batch size 32 and checkpoint saving every 2000 steps are consistent with the 151 recorded checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 当保存间隔为正时,训练循环会增加每个指定批次步骤的检查台计数. 像 epoch146.pth 这样的文件名不需要指第146个完成的训练时代. 就代表ResNet-50的时间表而言,30个图像批量大小32个时代和每个2000年节省的检查站都与记录的151个检查站一致。

blocks.en: For the Xception example in Section 5.1 , the GenImage log selects checkpoint 43 by mean accuracy across eight generators. A subsequent evaluation of the run’s best_epoch.pth reports 68.03 on Chameleon; the Chameleon sweep also reports 68.03 for checkpoint 43 and selects checkpoint 16 at 71.29. This is a log-level association, not an immutable weight-identity record or proof of prospective checkpoint freezing before inspecting Chameleon. GenImage cross-generator selection is not source-generator-only validation. The recorded difference demonstrates selection sensitivity, but does not isolate test-selection optimism from genuine differences between checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 对于第5.1节中的Xception例,Genimage日志以平均精度选择了8个发电机的43号检查站. 之后,对该跑队最佳战绩的评价是68.03次报道Chameleon;Chameleon扫荡也报道68.03次检查点43并选择了71.29次检查点16。 这是一个日志级协会,不是不可改变的体重识别记录,也不是检查变色龙前可能冻结检查站的证据。 GenImage 跨生成器选择不只用于源生成器验证. 所记录的差别表明对选择的敏感性,但并不将试选乐观与检查站之间的真正差别隔离开来。

blocks.en: A.4 Single-patch experiments and relation to EIB-Net
blocks.zh: A.4 单幅试验和与EIB-Net的关系

blocks.en: The single-patch baseline (SPD) uses exactly one selected region per image instance. Its documented default first resizes the image to a 256 × 256 256\times 256 canvas, forms a 4 × 4 4\times 4 grid, and chooses one 64 × 64 64\times 64 region. The original single-patch description includes backbone-dependent transforms after selection; this path is distinct from the multi-patch implementation above. The documented SPD training setup uses ImageNet initialization, seed 3407, and JPEG augmentation with probability 0.5 and quality 95. CNN runs use SGD with momentum 0.9 and initial learning rate 10 − 2 10^{-2} ; Transformer runs use AdamW with initial learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} and weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} .
blocks.zh: 单幅基线(SPD)每个图像实例精确使用一个选定的区域。 它所记录的默认首先将图像大小调整为256×256256\times 256画布,形成4×4 4\times 4网格,并选择一个64×6464\times 64区域. 最初的单幅描述包括了选取后依赖主干线的变换;这个路径与上面的多幅执行不同. 所记录的SPD训练设置采用ImageNet初始化,种子3407和JPEG增能,概率为0.5,质量为95. CNN运行使用有0.9动向和初始学习率的SGD 10−2 10−2};变形器运行使用有初始学习率的AdamW 10−4 10−4}和重量衰减 10−4 10−4} .

blocks.en: Minimum-, middle-, and maximum-complexity selection use the local variation statistic developed in our earlier research [ 17 ] . It sums absolute directional Laplacian-style responses and is not Shannon entropy. Selection changes which RGB crop is supplied; the statistic is not itself the detector input. Random selection uses no complexity score. SPD is a single-patch baseline, not the complete EIB-Net architecture: EIB-Net additionally includes a variational information bottleneck. The two studies share research origins, so their scores should not be treated as independent replications or as a controlled bottleneck ablation.

The detailed 128-pixel patch-size rows average to 91.4525 on GenImage and 91.53625 on AIGCDetectBenchmark; we correct the interchange of these means in the earlier summary table.

blocks.en: Appendix E Single-Patch Transfer Dynamics
blocks.zh: 附录 E 单批传输动态

blocks.en: The single-patch experiments also examine whether high validation accuracy transfers across scene domains. In the DiffusionForensics setting [ 14 ] , training and validation use the LSUN-Bedroom domain, while the reported test subsets use ImageNet scenes generated by ADM or SD v1. Figure 6 shows a ResNet-50 comparison using the 20% training-data setting. Both input choices approach saturated ADM validation accuracy, but their target-domain behavior differs: SPD remains substantially above the whole-image baseline on both target curves. The ADM and SD v1 test curves also differ from one another, despite similarly high source validation accuracy.
blocks.zh: 单平面实验还检查了是否在场景域间进行了高验证精度转移. 在"传播法"设置 [14]中,培训和验证使用LSUN-Bedroom域,而所报道的测试子集则使用由ADM或SD v1生成的ImageNet场景. 图6显示使用20%的培训数据进行了ResNet-50的比较。 两种输入选择都接近饱和ADM验证精度,但其目标域行为不同:SPD仍然大大高于两个目标曲线上的全图像基线. ADM和SD v1测试曲线也相去甚远,尽管源验证精度同样高.

blocks.en: This result motivates evaluating a detector beyond its training scene distribution. It supports the usefulness of local input in this particular transfer setting, but does not identify which feature caused the improvement. SPD changes the input representation and its transforms, and these single-patch runs are separate from the multi-patch benchmark study. The smoothed trajectories describe optimization behavior rather than independent repeated trials.
blocks.zh: 这一结果促使人们评估一个探测器在训练场面分布之外的情况。 它支持当地投入在这种特殊转让设置中的有用性,但并未确定导致改进的特征。 SPD改变输入表示及其变相,而这些单相克跑与多相克基准研究是分开的. 平滑的轨迹描述的是优化行为,而不是独立的重复试验.

It illustrates a gap between source validation and target-domain performance, not a confidence interval or a multi-seed estimate.

blocks.zh: 附录F 地方梯度统计分析.

blocks.en: The patch-based formulation is motivated partly by the possibility that nearby-pixel relationships carry evidence beyond convincing global image content. To examine this possibility with a simple descriptor, we analyze a gradient co-occurrence matrix (GCM), adapted from gray-level co-occurrence statistics [ 5 ] . This is a diagnostic analysis only: GCM is not an input, preprocessing step, loss term, or inference module of SPD or PWS.
blocks.zh: 以补丁为基础的配方部分是因为附近-像素关系可能携带的证据超出了令人信服的全球图像内容. 为了用一个简单的描述符来审查这种可能性,我们分析了从灰色同位素统计中改编的梯度同位素矩阵[5]. 这仅仅是诊断分析: GCM不是SPD或PWS的输入,预处理步骤,损失期,或推断模块.

blocks.en: F.2 Observed distribution differences
blocks.zh: F.2 观察到的分布差异

blocks.en: Figure 7 reports the ratio of mean image-level GCM entropy in real and synthetic subsets. The direction of the difference depends on the source: the displayed ratios are approximately 1.35 for DALL-E 2 and GLIDE, but 0.92 for Wukong and below one for several other subsets. These observations are inconsistent with a universal rule that generated images have lower local entropy. Instead, they suggest that a simple local statistic can shift in either direction across generation and data-processing pipelines.
blocks.zh: 图7报告了真子集和合成子集中平均图像级GCM等同位素的比例. 差异取向取决于出处:显示的比例DALL-E 2和GLIDE约为1.35,而Wukong和以下几个其他子集则分别为0.92. 这些观测结果与一种通用规则不一致,即生成的图像具有更低的局部 en. 相反,他们认为,简单的当地统计数据可以向两代人和数据处理管道的方向转变。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Exploratory GCM entropy ratios across 12 synthetic-image subsets. The dashed reference at one means equality of the two sample means, not equality of their full distributions. The original plot’s Natural Baseline label denotes this reference. Ratios both above and below one argue against a universal low-entropy detection rule.
blocks.zh: 图7:12个合成图像子集的探索性GCM en比. 一一的虚线指两个样本的等同性,而不是其全部分布的等同性. 原地块的"自然基线"标签表示此参考. 上下比率都与普遍低强度检测规则相悖。

blocks.en: Figure 8 compares the linear and stratified visualizations. Linear quantization concentrates much of the mass near the low-gradient corner, whereas stratification makes other transitions easier to inspect. The resulting differences depend on the quantizer: for example, the same subset need not exhibit the same ordering of mean entropies under both representations. Figure 9 further shows substantial overlap between real and generated entropy distributions. A scalar entropy threshold is therefore not a reliable universal detector in these examples.
blocks.zh: 图8比较了线性可视化和分层可视化. 线性量化将质量的大部分集中在低梯度角附近,而分层化则使得其他过渡更容易检查. 由此而来的差异取决于量子:例如,同一子集在两种表达法下都不需要表现出同等的正分位相. 图9还显示了真实的和生成的py分布之间的大量重叠. 因此,在这些例子中,scalar entropy阈值不是一个可靠的通用探测器.

blocks.en: These figures were produced during exploratory analysis, including revisions to range clipping and quantization; the saved linear implementation additionally uses 99th-percentile clipping. They should be read as related diagnostics, not as a matched comparison of quantizers on an identical fixed sample. Content, image resizing, compression, and the composition of real-image subsets can all contribute to the differences. No statistical significance claim or attribution to a unique generation mechanism follows from these plots. Their useful implication is narrower: local adjacency statistics are worth investigating, while the learned detector’s actual cues require separate analysis.
blocks.zh: 这些数字是在探索性分析中得出的,包括对测距剪接和量化的修订;节省下来的线性执行还使用了99-百分率剪接。 它们应被理解为相关的诊断,而不是在相同的固定样本上对定量剂进行比较。 内容,图像再大小,压缩,以及真实图像子集的构成,都可以促进差异. 这些地块没有提出具有统计意义的主张,也没有将它归于独特的一代人机制。 他们的有用含义比较狭窄:当地辅助数据值得调查,而学习的探测器的实际提示需要单独分析。

blocks.en: Figure 8: GCM visualizations under linear-range quantization (left) and dynamic stratification (right). Each group shows the real-image mean matrix, synthetic-image mean matrix, and absolute difference. Color ranges vary between panels. The structures reflect both image statistics and quantization; their appearance is not evidence that the neural detector uses the same features.
blocks.zh: 图8:线程量化(左)和动态分层(右)下的GCM可视化. 每个组都显示出真实图像平均值矩阵,合成图像平均值矩阵,以及绝对差异. 不同面板的颜色范围不同. 结构既反映了图像统计,也反映了量化;它们的外观并不是神经探测器使用相同特征的证据.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Exploratory image-level GCM entropy distributions across the examined subsets: box plots in the upper two rows and histograms in the lower two rows. Real and synthetic distributions overlap, and their relative positions vary by subset. These plots complement the ratios in Figure 7 ; they are not a detection benchmark or a statistical test of the learned representation.
blocks.zh: 图 9:探索图像级别 GCM 被检查子集之间的正弦分布:上两行的箱形地块和下两行的直方图. 真实和合成的分布重叠,它们的相对位置因子集而异. 这些图案补充了图7中的比率;它们不是检测基准,也不是对所学表现的统计测试。

blocks.en: Appendix G Patch Scores and Failure Cases
blocks.zh: 附录G 补丁得分和失败案例

blocks.en: The following examples use a ResNet-50 patch detector trained on ProGAN. Each map places synthetic-class scores back on the image. They visualize predictions, not pixel-level forgery annotations.
blocks.zh: 以下例子使用在ProGAN上训练的ResNet-50补丁探测器. 每张地图都将合成类分数放回图像上. 他们可视化预测,而不是像素级的伪造说明.

blocks.en: In Figure 10 , real photographs receive lower image-mean scores than the generated examples, but patches within one image need not agree. The Midjourney example contains mixed local responses while its average remains above the threshold. Aggregation combines these responses without establishing that every high-score region contains an identifiable artifact.
blocks.zh: 在图10中,真实相片得到的图像-平均值分数低于生成的示例,但一个图像中的补丁不需要同意. Midjourney的例子包括当地的反应有好有坏,而其平均值仍然高于门槛值。 汇总结合了这些反应,而没有确定每个高分区都包含一个可识别的文物.

blocks.en: Figure 10: Successful image-level predictions with patch-wise score maps. The left group contains generated images and the right group real photographs; warmer colors indicate higher synthetic-class scores. The shown average is the image-level score. Local colors are model predictions, not verified artifact locations.
blocks.zh: 图10:用补丁分数图成功进行图像级预测. 左组包含生成的图像和右组真实相片;更温暖的颜色表示更高的合成类分数. 显示的平均值是图像级分. 当地颜色是模型预测,没有经过核实的文物位置.

blocks.en: The Midjourney examples in Figure 11 are false negatives (0.2954 and 0.4649); the real GauGAN-subset examples are false positives (0.8454 and 0.9415). For the two real-image pairs below, resizing to 256 × 256 256\times 256 changes the scores from 0.1034 to 0.5818 and from 0.4123 to 0.9216, crossing the 0.5 threshold. These examples show processing sensitivity, but do not isolate interpolation, geometric distortion, or changed crop coverage as the cause.

blocks.en: Figure 11: Selected false negatives, false positives, and resizing-sensitive predictions. REAL/FAKE denotes the image label, not the predicted class. The upper examples show errors across three subsets; the lower pairs are real images before and after resizing. These are illustrative cases rather than an estimate of failure frequencies.
